S.FORM: alisalap 蜈蚣 alisalap u heci ku kaneng nuheni. alisalap yadah ku kitidaan nuheni makatukuh i Pai-ci-cun. masadumaay a ngangan nu Hulam:蜈蚣 nu Amilika:centipede nu Lipun:ムカデ Chilopoda (mitesekay a ngangan)Chilopoda 蜈蚣 (tada ngangan)alisalap udip . alisalap u yadahay ku kuku' nu bilbil kuku' atekakay, sa tanayu' sa ku udip, nu cacaya a batacan tusa ku kuku'. 300隻腳的. alisalap han singangan naca' tu cacay a lasubu nu kuku' a cilekay, tatengan caay namin kalecad ku kuku' nuheni, idaw ku mawadaay tu tusa a bataan a kukuan, idaw ku milakuyday tu tulu a lasubuan a kuku'. idaw ku masa dumaay a alisalapan siwa a bataan idaw ku enem a kuku'an, alisalap han idaw namin ku matatiwuyday a kakuku'an, tinakusa nu sabaw tu lima atu sabaw tu pitu a kakuku'an, sisa, inai ku matatungusay tu cacay a lasubuwan a kuku'an nu alisalap. (mata)hatidaay tu nu alisalapan inai' ku mata, nika idaw ku alisalap nu masacacaya nu mata, nika nina cacaya a mataan alahican pulungen nuheni ku adidiay a mataan alaw masamata, nika ina mahiniay a mataan u takelalsa atu duu'd ku adihan, caay pakaadih tu tatengaay a aadihan. picidekan picidekan nu alisalapsa u sayaway nu batacan i nu ayawan ku masaacawaay a sidukuay nu kuku'an (forcipule), kapicedekan nu alisalap taneng micucuk tu duku i ngangucudan nu ayawan a kuku'. udip nu alisalap idaw ku adidiay nu alisalap atu i ba'ba'ay a alisalap, idaw ku tabakiay makaala tu tuluay a bataan a kunfun nu alisalapan, kulit nu alisalap u lalaay a kulit atu celacelahan atu kalasumasumanahan a kulit, caay kalecad ku kakitidaan sisa caay kalecad ku kulit. idaw ku mahicaay a alisalap nu sayaway a cepian mahida u ngawa a kuku', caay kahida nu dumaan a ngawa', misudikuday ku kuku' nuheni. tangah nu alisalap makimulmul atu mata'pis, singawa' i tangah. . idaw ku maha tusaay a sangucud atu sapiputun a laway nu alisalap, atu mala tusaay a sapitaneng atu sakan tu tuud a adidiay a sangucud . 第一對Maxilla包含小顎鬚,形成下唇. saka cacay nu maha tusaay "Malilla" adidiay a ngingis mala i sasaay a bilbilan. sayaway nu batacan a mikapiay a kuku' nama kayda i udip misatanayu', matahap ku laway nu dumaan, nina mikapaiay a kuku' nu sadikuday idaw ku dukuay a kuku', taneng mipadang tu alisalap mikema atu mipatay tu aadupan a tuud. alisalap idaw ku cihek nuheni, itida i angangan nu ngawaw', masasalaay ku kaku' atu mahida u sipaw milawa' tu tebanay a buhung, taneng sapitiyung, atu sapitengilaw tu suni. udip nu alisalap mapulung sabaw tu lima a batacan, nu saka cacay a batacan nisatanayuan a laway atu sadikuday nu tasaay a babatac i nai' ku kuku', u babatacan idaw namin ku malaacaawaay nu tusaay a kukuan. nu malaacawaay nu kuku'an mikiayaw tu nu ayawan a kuku' tu tanayu', kya kalamkam ku nuheni muculil sakacaay ka sasetul. . sadikuday a kuku' nuheni miki tanayu tu sayaway a kukuan nu tusay a bay ku tanayu. alisalap nu sadikuday a batac idaw ku kikul, idaw ku tamenahan nuheni mutuwaw tu. alisalap tada u ngawan ku sapiadup nuheni. batacan nu alisalap idaw ku mutuwa'ay tu atu hahanhannan. . idaw aca ku tusaay a "ma-se-guan" u tatai'an nuheni. . kalamkam malawpes ku namaka udipay a nanum, sisa manamuh i masengetay a kitidaan ku henin micunus tu nanum, tinaku sa i lala'lala'an, numa saupuay nu papah, baba'tuwan atu isasa nu malahulay a kilang. duku Forcipule Forcipule的頂端. "Forcipule" taneng miadup, cucukan tu duku, caay kaw tatengay nu alisalap a laway. ya duku namakayda ilabu milakuyd tu ngangucuhan katukuh i "Forcipule" a tungduh. . duku nu alisalap mahida nu kaketi a duku, miadada, nika caay pipatay, hatidaay nu alisalap aadidi' namin ku udip, adidi ku duku. anu makala satu, sakapahay han mibanaw i sayaway atu misiwduku tu nikalatan, pakuli han tu miwada' tu nika lebawaw atu adada, pina a dimiad mahpectu ku lebawa hidasatu mangay. babalaki anu makalad nu alisalap, micidek ku adada', malebawaw, mamilmil, sinicu, atu nai' ku icelng nu udip, nika caay kapatay ku tademaw. anu makalad nu alisalap ku wawa atu makaway a tademaw micidek ku nika adada, makaway a tademaw alaw amasatedep ku hanhanan. inai'ay nu duku a alisalap hina mapacekuk ku tademaw, u mahiniay yu muculil kunuheni sa yadah ku kuku' nuheni muculil, nika hina i duu'day ku nuheni tahekal, pasayda i kuku'kuku'an nu tademaw. duma Mi-lu satabakiay nu alisalap inihenay henay i kitakitan u satabakiay nu alisalap, anu mapatay satu makaal tu tulu a bataan a kun-fun, satabakiay ni kilukan makaala' tu talu a bataan idaw ku enem a kun-fun, mukanay tu kakitil, balaud, mabahelay a ayam, du', atu pidaduki, singipenay a aadupan (pawalil)... atu kakatu. namakayniay a nasulitan nasakamuan atu natinengan
